integrity: The finite coefficient tables were exhaustively regenerated and checked using standalone exact-arithmetic code. An analytic inequality proves the sign for all integer horizons; finite testing alone was not used for the universal claim. All referenced authors retain credit for their original models and expectation results.
scientific_limitations: The pointwise classification applies only to independent, uniformly sampled projective lines of PG(2,2) or PG(2,3) against all equally likely point blocks of the same size. No general result for higher projective orders or other mechanisms is asserted. Standard inclusion-exclusion and finite projective-incidence enumerations are not claimed new. A prior equivalent distributional comparison could exist.
title: Sharp crossing of projective-plane coupon-coverage tails
